notes: Archived pre-correction config derived from Phase 95 reward_jon_p95_peak875_hdisceff/seed_004; legacy selected-policy identifiers are retained for provenance and API compatibility.
The policy uses operational SPR days_remaining advice, not perfect-future SPR knowledge.

The hard screen compares against historical management on no spill, storage, ESA minimum flow, flood-safe days, all four SPR threshold frequencies, hydropower, and NIIP annual volume. NIIP daily timing is retained as a diagnostic but not a hard pass/fail criterion.
Training hydrology is annual holdout-mean bias adjusted for San Juan inflow, evaporation, and Animas Farmington flow.

experiments.name: selected_policy_navajo_reservoir
experiments.description: Archived pre-correction Navajo Reservoir policy candidate: operational SPR advice, split action heads, four-action release controller, high-storage target, discretionary hydropower-efficiency shaping, and annual bias-corrected training hydrology.
experiments.experiment_reason: Seed 004 was the pre-correction Phase 95 paper candidate under the metrics used at that time. It is retained as an archived baseline and is not the final corrected paper policy.
experiments.reward_summary:
Dam safety: spill guard with warning pressure starting at 98% storage (alpha 1.00)
Storage: 87.5% fixed peak-storage target with concave low-storage recovery and soft upper guard near 98% (alpha 2.50)
Hydropower: positive generation reward with efficiency shaping only on discretionary San Juan release (alpha 1.50)
Flood control: penalize downstream flow-cap exceedance (alpha 0.25)
NIIP: historic delivery match with hard-meet credit and softened overdelivery, evaluated primarily by annual volume (alpha 3.00)
ESA minimum flow: smooth logistic reward for maintaining the 500 cfs Farmington minimum flow, with ESA action capped at 1.50x daily deficit (alpha 2.50)
SPR: operational no-future threshold proxy ledger with strong excess-release penalty and days_remaining advice (alpha 2.00)
Action/controller: four-action MAX architecture for ESA/baseflow, NIIP, SPR bridge release, and discretionary San Juan release
Training hydrology: annual holdout-mean matched San Juan inflow, evaporation, and Animas Farmington flow
